sn19.8:1.4: _Sūta_ is a member of the king’s guard standing in line between the King’s brother and a village headman (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 5.4.4.17) charged with care of war horses, an “equerry” (Atharva Veda 3.5.7, Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 3.4.1.7, Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 4.3.37). Perhaps the needles are like the lashes he used to inflict on the horses he trained.
